_comment: Classifies transKeys (lang_translatorKey) as literal/interlinear translations vs adapted
literary ones. The TOC always shows an interlinear translation as a separate, first link
before the regular translator badges — everything NOT listed here is treated as literary.
Pure data, no logic: add a key here if a translator produces an interlinear translation;
if 'o' (the project's own translator) ever also produces a literary/adapted version under
a different key, that new key simply stays out of this list and renders as a normal badge.
